column1: # Words that offer an emoji while typing: keyword, emoji (best first, at most five), kind.
# Kinds: word keeps the word and adds the emoji after it; sound (haha, huhu), emoticon (:)) and
# yahoo (Yahoo! Messenger codes, behind the YahooEmoticons option) are replaced by the emoji.
# Country names come from CLDR in misc/gen-emoji-keywords.py. The first block is picked by hand:
# CLDR keywords alone include words such as `có` and `không`.
# Short names CLDR leaves out; not "Anh" or "Trung", which start sentences and names.
# Emoji names from CLDR (annotations/vi.xml) that are a whole word, minus syllables that mostly
# appear inside other words, such as cáo in báo cáo or tất in tất cả.
# Yahoo! Messenger 5.5 to 9 emoticons, typed in any case. The old codes above stay on with the option off.
